title: Interpret a model with its declared metamodel
description: Identify the metamodel and representation profile governing a selected engineering state and expose its supported entity and relationship meaning. This establishes interpretation context, not a conformance judgment.
inputs: Selected engineering model state and its declared metamodel/profile identity.
Available retained metamodel and representation definitions.
outputs: Identifiable interpretation context and governing entity, relationship, identity, naming, lifecycle, and validity definitions.
Explicit unavailable, ambiguous, or unsupported interpretation outcome.
behavior: Resolve the rule selection declared by the chosen state rather than substituting the newest profile.
Associate interpreted content with that selected metamodel and profile.
Make governing definitions available for subsequent authorship, checking, and migration.
Retain the distinction between current authoring selection and historical interpretation.

failure_behavior.condition: The selected state does not identify one governing profile.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the absent or ambiguous rule selection without inventing it.

failure_behavior.condition: The retained profile is unavailable or unsupported by the current interpreter.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the limit and preserve the original profile designation without claiming conformance under another profile.
Identify the conflict and withhold unqualified interpretation for the affected scope.

sources.basis: IR-005 / SR-012 confirms attributable model interpretation; SR-013 and SR-015 reuse this context for checks and migration.

Propose MOD-003 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
